facingNote: Side/three-quarter profile facing RIGHT; the engine flips horizontally for leftward travel.

damselfly.notes: Slimmer damselfly, 17x10 cell, teal-blue. Needle abdomen (water-mid/sky-high with cornflower flashes, ink/water-deep underside) ending in a 1px tip; compact thorax with corn-shade shadow; large sky-high eye with a cream glint and ink rim. Wings are held close and folded over the abdomen: a 2px pale near-wing blade (wing leading, foam membrane) with a 1px cornflower far-wing blade above it, tips tapering 1px and stopping short of the tail so the abdomen silhouette stays clear. Four-frame folded wingbeat: the whole bundle lifts 1px, presses 1px, and sweeps its tip 1px fore/aft (spans 8/9/8/7px). The body, head and tail are pixel-identical in all four frames (fully anchored, no tail flick); the only changed pixels are the folded wing bundle. No baked shadow.
